name: Carrion Defense Works Bioelectric Camouflage Generator BCG-2
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Bioelectric Camouflage Generator BCG-2
description: A body-worn device that generates a configurable bioelectric field mimicking the signature of a different person, animal, or no living being at all. The BCG-2 can spoof biometric sensors that detect heartbeat, bioelectric brain activity, galvanic skin response, and body impedance — the sensor reads whatever the BCG-2 tells it to read. The device can make the wearer appear dead to biometric scanners, mimic the bioelectric signature of a specific individual for access control bypass, or generate the signature of an animal to explain detection without raising alarm. Carrion developed it for covert operators who need to defeat biometric perimeter security.

specifications.info: clone (specific individual); mask (animal); custom; brain activity; skin response; impedance
specifications.programming: Neural interface or manual preset selection

story_hooks: A secured area's biometric perimeter showed no living presence during a time when a theft was committed — the intruder used a BCG-2 in null mode, appearing as a walking dead zone to every sensor.
A BCG-2 was used to clone an executive's bioelectric signature and gain access to a biometric-locked facility — the intrusion was undetectable because the sensors saw exactly the right person.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Pulse Carbine PC-6 'Heartbeat'

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact modular control unit with a secondary emission pack, resembling a chunky tactical belt accessory. The main module features a slightly curved form factor designed to conform against the hip or lower back, with a secondary electrode array pack connected via reinforced flex-cable. The overall aesthetic is utilitarian and encrypted-looking, with a matte finish interrupted by subtle indicator elements.
physical_description.dimensions: Main module 12cm x 8cm x 4cm; electrode pack 18cm x 6cm x 2cm; total span with flex-cable approximately 35cm when worn
physical_description.weight_description: Light enough for all-day wear (0.2 kg total); distributes across belt integration points to avoid sagging or creating visible bulges under clothing
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polymer composite housing with embedded conductive mesh lining; electrode pack uses biocompatible silicone contact interface with titanium contact points
physical_description.finish: Military-grade matte charcoal coating with faint iridescent anti-glare sheen; electrode pack has textured medical-grade silicone in gunmetal gray
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black primary body with gunmetal gray accents; status indicators glow in soft amber, blue, and red against the dark housing
physical_description.interface_elements: Recessed capacitive touch surface for mode selection (five-point input grid); two-line monochrome LCD display (amber-on-dark); three status LEDs (power, active field, battery); proprietary neural-interface port (pogo connector array); micro USB charging port (recessed, security-gated)
distinctive_features: Subtle pulse-synchronized LED breathing pattern when active—mimics resting heartbeat to indicate operational status
Flex-cable umbilicus connecting control module to electrode array, reinforced with braided shielding to prevent RF interference
Intricate circuit-board etching visible through translucent accent panel on rear (design choice emphasizing technical sophistication)
Faint haptic feedback pulsing during mode transition—felt as subtle vibration against wearer's body
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS embossed in beveled lettering on front bezel; regulatory compliance stamps (GLMZ-certified, counter-surveillance licensed) in small print on underside; serial number laser-etched into module frame
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn snug against body under tactical clothing or loose streetwear; electrode pack adhered to skin with medical-grade conductive patches; barely visible unless wearer removes outer layer or moves in ways that expose belt line
